alt: Colorful Lollipop Star bone-conduction candy sticks displayed at CES 2026
story: Lollipop Star debuted at CES 2026 as a single-use bone-conduction candy that beams celebrity songs through your jawbone to your inner ear, but only if you also wear earplugs to block ambient noise — after one session you throw away a plastic stick containing a lithium battery and a circuit board.
why_funny: The 'Worst in Show' at CES 2026: you eat a $9 lollipop, plug your ears, and chew for music — the candy IS the speaker, the landfill IS the packaging.
